header: Build hunting queries using guided mode in Microsoft Defender
content:
in Microsoft Defender
03/28/2025Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal
The query builder in guided mode allows analysts to craft meaningful hunting queries without
knowing Kusto Query Language (KQL) or the data schema. Analysts from every tier of
experience can use the query builder to filter through data from the last 30 days to look for
threats, expand incident investigations, perform data analytics on threat data, or focus on
specific threat areas.
The analyst can choose which data set to look at and which filters and conditions to use to
narrow the data down to what they need.
You can watch this video to get an overview of guided hunting:
In the Advanced hunting page, select Create new to open a new query tab and select Query in
builder.
